title: Wear any ribbon you have earned
notes: Trainer card: a new Titles button lists every ribbon you have earned, with filters, two orders and pages, so any of them can be your title again (phones too).
fixes: Two saves: rare finds from the save you didn’t keep now still come back by mail when that device only caught up later.
Phones: wearing a ribbon’s title, or closing the Titles list, takes you back to your trainer card.
Move Tutor: Low Key Toxtricity, Rotom’s appliance forms and female Meowstic can now learn every move their species can.
Card Bloom cards no longer vanish once a Pokémon has many bloomed. Any that went missing come back by themselves.

title: Your Showcase on the Share card
notes: Share card: it now shows your Showcase picks, in your order (your rarest and your party only fill empty spots).
Classic window: the Community tab now sits right after Mart with the other tabs.

Small extras: a Not favourites choice in the PC’s Show menu, a Not in my Stamp book filter on the Night Market, and the encounter chime on its own switch in Settings. Blackjack’s table now says a Same-type 21 needs 3+ cards.
fixes: PC: clicking a Pokémon now always opens that Pokémon’s own card, and the card’s buttons act on it (in a few PCs, two Pokémon opened the same card).
Boss War: the counter planner now closes straight away and saves in the background, so it can no longer leave the game unclickable.
Auto-battle: a Legendary or Mythical now always gets your best ball, even when it is only being caught as new to your Pokédex.
Golden Leaf encores: a Wonder Trade, gift or bounty quest you can’t do any more today is swapped for another quest by itself, and a board never keeps two of them.
Bounty board: the new-species bounty never asks for more species than you can still find in the wild on your islands.
Tower: catch and egg pop-ups wait while the Tower is on screen, so they no longer push it up and down or cover the path map.

title: Fixes for stuck screens and more
notes: Top finds: a new All time list shows the 100 rarest finds ever.
Live now shows your friends’ newest rare finds and refreshes by itself while it’s open.
Festival: the Events and Festival tabs now show a dot when an Encore quest is ready to claim.
fixes: Very rare finds now show their real odds instead of stopping at 1 in 1B.
Windows: after you Alt-Tab back to Tallgrass, the keyboard works again straight away.
The away cards summary no longer blocks every button when it shows up together with Welcome back.
Fixed the away cards summary sometimes closing with an error while eggs were waiting to hatch.
Guild Boss War: the Plan window always closes now, even when your plan can’t be saved yet.
Encore quests: the board no longer fills up with daily-limited quests (bounties, gifts, Wonder Trades, raids) that you can’t finish today.
Buy & use on an evolution item now evolves the Pokémon you picked, even with auto item evolutions on.
Night Market and Auctions: some Pokémon caught a few days ago no longer say they aren’t yours to sell.
Hard Mode Tower: throws no longer fail with “not in this run’s bag” while you still have Poké Balls.
Gyms: fixed a Gym fight that kept asking you to try again in a minute.
Night Market: the page no longer keeps zooming in and out when you change tag or page.
A hatch card cut short by a battle no longer hides the new Pokémon from your PC and Pokédex.
Smoother saving for very big collections: big PC uploads no longer start over from scratch after a slow moment.
